builder_policy: Use existing Lima instance and record installed toolchain. No global package installation, device credentials, hardware access or image build.
qualification: Frozen native source/package inputs, exact OS/custom closure, detached activation and independent root verification passed. The pipeline receipt binds host tests, captured preparation, native failure/interruption fixtures and exact BSP replay. Full image export, physical boot, hardware and battery acceptance remain separate.
reproducibility: Capture source hashes, package hashes and builder inventory. Byte-identical rebuilds are not claimed.
target: Debian Trixie on the existing native ARM64 builder
